case_name: State of Punjab and Another v Balkaran Singh
respondent:
Balkaran Singh
Supreme Court of India

18 October 2006
Appeal (Civil) 5847 of 2005 [Along with C.A. No. 5854 of 2005 and C.A. No. 5853 of 2005]
The Judgment was delivered by: P. K. Balasubramanyan, J.
1. These appeals by special leave are by the State of Punjab and its Director of Agriculture. They challenge the judgments and decrees in three different suits filed by three officers of the Agricultural Department of the State, essentially claiming pay at enhanced scale in two of the suits and seniority over certain
holding: The decrees granted by the courts below in the two suits, i.e., Civil Suit No. 665 of 1993 and Civil Suit No. 894 of 1993 are unsustainable in law and the decrees deserve to be reversed.
All three suits are dismissed with costs in the trial court.
The judgments and decrees granted by the courts below are set aside.
